proposals.title: Require embryo provenance and composition/state decomposition before biological claims
proposals.claim: A pooled expression match cannot certify within-compartment state accuracy without independent composition measurements and embryo-level replication.
proposals.mechanism: Treat de_score and de_direction as predictive diagnostics, separating frozen-state composition reweighting from within-state changes; independent embryo contrasts and abundance assays reveal composition-driven matches. This is a validation requirement, not a promised metric gain.
proposals.falsifier: With eligible data, compare composition-only and state-changing predictions against blinded compartment counts and replicate-aware within-compartment readouts. If these endpoints agree for both, the proposed decomposition does not distinguish their biological validity.

evidence.says: Warns that cells sharing an embryo/sample are not independent biological replicates.
Proxy selects the first at most 150 candidate and target rows rather than a sample-balanced cloud.

evidence.ref: Squair et al., Confronting false discoveries in single-cell differential expression, Nature Communications, 2021, doi:10.1038/s41467-021-25960-2
evidence.says: Publisher-indexed excerpts report false discoveries when biological replicate variability is ignored.

proposals.title: Attach an orthogonal observation requirement to each mechanistic claim
proposals.claim: Transcriptomic trajectories alone cannot validate ancestry or direct regulatory effects; claims need independent lineage or timed perturbation observations.
proposals.mechanism: de_direction and neighborhood_mmd can improve without correct ancestry or direct regulation. Require lineage recording for ancestry and timed restricted perturbation plus functional rescue for mechanism; report anatomy separately from scored expression diagnostics.
proposals.falsifier: Audit every claimed lineage/regulatory conclusion: suspend it if only transcriptomic similarity or transport is supplied. Eligible future assays must contradict or corroborate a preregistered observation, with protected-target assays quarantined post-competition.

evidence.says: Explicitly distinguishes biologically plausible stories from biological validation.

evidence.ref: Raj et al., Simultaneous single-cell profiling of lineages and cell types in the vertebrate brain, Nature Biotechnology, 2018, doi:10.1038/nbt.4103
evidence.says: scGESTALT combines heritable lineage recording with transcriptome-based cell identification in zebrafish.
